description:
PilotNest is the iPhone and iPad companion for MacPilot. Connect to your Mac over a local network to view its desktop, use a mouse trackpad and type remotely. You can also lock, blank, unlock or wake and unlock the Mac. A nearby Bluetooth fallback supports control when Wi-Fi is unavailable; remote video requires a network connection.

Highlights
• Live remote desktop preview with pinch zoom
• Relative mouse trackpad, dragging, multi-finger scrolling and pressure simulation
• Remote keyboard input and common shortcuts
• One-tap Lock / Blank / Unlock / Wake & Unlock
• Multiple Macs, automatic discovery and IP / hostname connections
• Connect across networks using Tailscale configured on both devices
• Pair with a 6-digit code; traffic is encrypted after pairing

Requirements
Install MacPilot on your Mac and enable Remote Control. Desktop video requires Screen Recording permission; mouse and keyboard control require Accessibility permission:
https://github.com/misswell/MacPilot

Privacy
PilotNest does not collect user data. Control traffic is encrypted between paired devices. Your Mac login password stays on the Mac and is never sent to your phone.
whatsNew:
Make your remote-control layout your own: arrange controls within sections and reorder whole sections without mixing them together.

New
• Page Up, Page Down, Home and End controls for the foreground app on your Mac. They are off by default; enable the keys you want in Control features.
• Automatic switching when the selected Mac is unavailable and just one other paired Mac remains discoverable for 10 seconds. Manual switching takes priority during the current use session.

Improved
• Keep mute beside the volume slider as a compact, icon-only control.
• Touch and hold to reorder controls while keeping their visibility preferences and section layout.
• Optional Bluetooth identity checks help updated MacPilot recognize an explicitly linked BLE Unlock device when its Bluetooth identifier changes.

Fixed
• Open Section order reliably from the toolbar and keep both section and control order after reopening the app.

Update MacPilot to use the new navigation keys and optional Bluetooth identity checks. Existing controls remain compatible with older Macs.
